refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Network is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Network
type LinkState( pending, initialized, configuring, configured, unmanaged, failed, linger )
type LinkAddressState( off, degraded, routable )
type LinkOnlineState( offline, partial, online )
type LinkRequiredAddressFamily( any, ipv4, ipv6, both )
type Address( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # IP address Address: []int, # IP address (human-readable format) AddressString: string, # Peer address for point-to-point interfaces Peer: ?[]int, # Peer address for point-to-point interfaces (human-readable format) PeerString: ?string, # Network prefix length PrefixLength: int, # Configuration source for this address ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider (DHCP server, router, etc.) ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (DHCP server, router, etc.) (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string, # Broadcast address for IPv4 networks Broadcast: ?[]int, # Broadcast address for IPv4 networks (human-readable format) BroadcastString: ?string, # Address scope (RT_SCOPE_* value) Scope: ?int, # Human-readable scope string ScopeString: ?string, # Address flags (IFA_F_* values) Flags: ?int, # Human-readable flags string FlagsString: ?string, # Address label for IPv4 Label: ?string, # Preferred lifetime in microseconds PreferredLifetimeUSec: ?int, # Preferred lifetime in microseconds (deprecated, for backward compatibility) PreferredLifetimeUsec: ?int, # Valid lifetime in microseconds ValidLifetimeUSec: ?int, # Valid lifetime in microseconds (deprecated, for backward compatibility) ValidLifetimeUsec: ?int, # Configuration state of this address ConfigState: ?string )
type BitRates( # Transmit bitrate in bits per second TxBitRate: int, # Receive bitrate in bits per second RxBitRate: int )
type DHCPLease( # Timestamp when the lease was acquired in microseconds LeaseTimestampUSec: ?int, # T1 timeout (lease renewal time) in microseconds Timeout1USec: ?int, # T2 timeout (lease rebinding time) in microseconds Timeout2USec: ?int, # Hostname received from DHCP server Hostname: ?string )
type DHCPServer( # Offset from the network address for the DHCP address pool PoolOffset: int, # Size of the DHCP address pool PoolSize: int, # Active DHCP leases assigned by the server Leases: ?[]DHCPServerLease, # Static DHCP leases configured for specific clients StaticLeases: ?[]DHCPServerLease )
type DHCPServerLease( # DHCP client identifier ClientId: ?[]int, # Address assigned to the client Address: ?[]int, # Address assigned to the client (human-readable format) AddressString: ?string, # Hostname provided by the DHCP client Hostname: ?string, # Hardware address type (ARPHRD_* value) HardwareAddressType: ?int, # Length of hardware address in bytes HardwareAddressLength: ?int, # Hardware (MAC) address of the DHCP client HardwareAddress: ?[]int, # Lease expiration time in monotonic microseconds ExpirationUSec: ?int, # Lease expiration time in realtime microseconds ExpirationRealtimeUSec: ?int )
type DHCPv6Client( # DHCPv6 lease information including timestamps and timeouts Lease: ?DHCPLease, # Delegated prefixes received from DHCPv6 server Prefixes: ?[]DHCPv6ClientPD, # Vendor-specific options received in DHCPv6 response VendorSpecificOptions: ?[]DHCPv6ClientVendorOption, # DHCP Unique Identifier (DUID) of the client DUID: []int )
type DHCPv6ClientPD( # Delegated IPv6 prefix Prefix: ?[]int, # Human-readable delegated IPv6 prefix PrefixString: ?string, # Length of the delegated prefix in bits PrefixLength: int, # Preferred lifetime of the prefix in microseconds PreferredLifetimeUSec: ?int, # Valid lifetime of the prefix in microseconds ValidLifetimeUSec: ?int )
type DHCPv6ClientVendorOption( # IANA enterprise number identifying the vendor EnterpriseId: int, # Vendor-specific sub-option code SubOptionCode: int, # Raw data of the vendor-specific sub-option SubOptionData: string )
type DNS( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # DNS server IP address Address: []int, # DNS server IP address (human-readable format) AddressString: string, # DNS server port number Port: ?int, # Interface index for link-local DNS servers InterfaceIndex: ?int, # DNS server hostname for DoT/DoH ServerName: ?string, # Configuration source for this DNS server ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string )
type DNSSECNegativeTrustAnchor( # Domain name for which DNSSEC validation is disabled DNSSECNegativeTrustAnchor: string, # Configuration source for this negative trust anchor ConfigSource: string )
type DNSSetting( # Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution setting LLMNR: ?string, # Multicast DNS setting MDNS: ?string, # Whether this connection can be used as a default route for DNS lookups DNSDefaultRoute: ?bool, # DNS-over-TLS mode setting DNSOverTLS: ?string, # Configuration source for this DNS setting ConfigSource: string )
type Domain( # DNS search or route domain name Domain: string, # Configuration source for this domain ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string )
type Interface( # Network interface index Index: int, # Primary interface name Name: string, # Alternative interface names AlternativeNames: ?[]string, # Interface index of the master device (for bridge/bond slaves) MasterInterfaceIndex: ?int, # Interface kind (vlan, bridge, bond, etc.) Kind: ?string, # Interface type (ether, loopback, etc.) Type: string, # Kernel driver name Driver: ?string, # Interface flags (IFF_* values) Flags: int, # Human-readable interface flags FlagsString: string, # Kernel operational state (IF_OPER_* value) KernelOperationalState: int, # Human-readable kernel operational state KernelOperationalStateString: string, # Current MTU in bytes MTU: int, # Minimum allowed MTU in bytes MinimumMTU: int, # Maximum allowed MTU in bytes MaximumMTU: int, # Current hardware (MAC) address HardwareAddress: ?[]int, # Permanent hardware (MAC) address from factory PermanentHardwareAddress: ?[]int, # Broadcast address for Ethernet interfaces BroadcastAddress: ?[]int, # IPv6 link-local address IPv6LinkLocalAddress: ?[]int, # IPv6 link-local address (human-readable format) IPv6LinkLocalAddressString: ?string, # Wireless LAN interface type (NL80211_IFTYPE_* value) WirelessLanInterfaceType: ?int, # Human-readable wireless LAN interface type WirelessLanInterfaceTypeString: ?string, # Wireless network SSID SSID: ?string, # Wireless access point BSSID (MAC address) BSSID: ?[]int, # Administrative state (configuring, configured, etc.) AdministrativeState: LinkState, # Operational state (routable, degraded, etc.) OperationalState: string, # Carrier state (carrier, no-carrier, etc.) CarrierState: string, # Address configuration state AddressState: LinkAddressState, # IPv4 address configuration state IPv4AddressState: LinkAddressState, # IPv6 address configuration state IPv6AddressState: LinkAddressState, # Online state (online, offline, etc.) OnlineState: ?LinkOnlineState, # Path to .network configuration file NetworkFile: ?string, # Paths to .network drop-in configuration files NetworkFileDropins: ?[]string, # Whether this interface is required for online state RequiredForOnline: ?bool, # Required operational state range for considering interface online [min, max] RequiredOperationalStateForOnline: ?[]string, # Required address family for considering interface online RequiredFamilyForOnline: ?LinkRequiredAddressFamily, # Activation policy (up, always-up, manual, etc.) ActivationPolicy: ?string, # Path to .netdev configuration file NetDevFile: ?string, # Paths to .netdev drop-in configuration files NetDevFileDropins: ?[]string, # Path to .link configuration file LinkFile: ?string, # Paths to .link drop-in configuration files LinkFileDropins: ?[]string, # Device path in sysfs Path: ?string, # Hardware vendor name Vendor: ?string, # Hardware model name Model: ?string, # DNS servers configured for this interface DNS: ?[]DNS, # Discovery of Network-designated Resolvers (RFC9463) DNR: ?[]object, # NTP servers configured for this interface NTP: ?[]NTP, # SIP servers configured for this interface SIP: ?[]SIP, # DNS search domains SearchDomains: ?[]Domain, # DNS route-only domains RouteDomains: ?[]Domain, # DNSSEC negative trust anchors DNSSECNegativeTrustAnchors: ?[]DNSSECNegativeTrustAnchor, # DNS resolution settings (LLMNR, mDNS, etc.) DNSSettings: ?[]DNSSetting, # Captive portal detection URL (RFC8910) CaptivePortal: ?string, # IPv6 Neighbor Discovery information NDisc: ?NDisc, # IP addresses configured on this interface Addresses: ?[]Address, # Neighbor entries (ARP/NDP cache) Neighbors: ?[]Neighbor, # Next hops for multipath routing NextHops: ?[]NextHop, # Routes configured on this interface Routes: ?[]Route, # DHCP server configuration and leases DHCPServer: ?DHCPServer, # DHCPv4 client configuration and lease information DHCPv4Client: ?object, # DHCPv6 client configuration and lease information DHCPv6Client: ?DHCPv6Client, # LLDP transmit configuration for this interface LLDP: ?LLDPNeighbor, # Current transmit/receive bitrates from speed meter BitRates: ?BitRates )
type LLDPNeighbor( # Chassis identifier in human-readable format ChassisID: ?string, # Raw chassis identifier bytes RawChassisID: []int, # Port identifier in human-readable format PortID: string, # Raw port identifier bytes RawPortID: []int, # Description of the port PortDescription: ?string, # System name of the LLDP neighbor SystemName: ?string, # System description of the LLDP neighbor SystemDescription: ?string, # Enabled capabilities bitmap (bridge, router, WLAN, etc.) EnabledCapabilities: int, # Manufacturer Usage Description URL (RFC8520) MUDURL: ?string, # VLAN identifier VlanID: ?int )
type LLDPNeighborsByInterface( # Network interface index InterfaceIndex: int, # Primary interface name InterfaceName: string, # Alternative interface names InterfaceAlternativeNames: ?[]string, # LLDP neighbors discovered on this interface Neighbors: []LLDPNeighbor )
type NDisc( # PREF64 (RFC8781) prefixes advertised via IPv6 Router Advertisements PREF64: ?[]Pref64 )
type Neighbor( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # IP address of the neighbor Destination: []int, # IP address of the neighbor (human-readable format) DestinationString: string, # Link layer (MAC) address of the neighbor LinkLayerAddress: []int, # Configuration source for this neighbor entry ConfigSource: string, # Configuration state of this neighbor entry ConfigState: string )
type NextHop( # Next hop identifier ID: int, # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # Gateway address for this next hop Gateway: ?[]int, # Gateway address for this next hop (human-readable format) GatewayString: ?string, # Next hop flags (RTNH_F_* values) Flags: ?int, # Human-readable flags string FlagsString: ?string, # Routing protocol identifier Protocol: ?int, # Human-readable routing protocol name ProtocolString: ?string, # Whether this is a blackhole next hop (drops packets) Blackhole: ?bool, # Multipath group members with weights for load balancing Group: ?[]NextHopGroup, # Configuration source for this next hop ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string, # Configuration state of this next hop ConfigState: ?string )
type NextHopGroup( # Next hop identifier in the multipath group ID: int, # Weight for load balancing (higher means more traffic) Weight: int )
type NTP( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) for address-based servers Family: ?int, # NTP server IP address Address: ?[]int, # NTP server IP address (human-readable format) AddressString: ?string, # NTP server Server: ?string, # Configuration source for this NTP server ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string )
type Pref64( # IPv6 prefix for NAT64/DNS64 Prefix: ?[]int, # Human-readable IPv6 prefix PrefixString: ?string, # Length of the prefix in bits PrefixLength: int, # Lifetime of the prefix in microseconds LifetimeUSec: ?int, # Address of router that provided this prefix ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of router that provided this prefix (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string )
type PrivateOption( # DHCP option number Option: ?int, # Raw data of the private DHCP option PrivateOptionData: ?string )
type Route( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # Destination network address Destination: []int, # Destination network address (human-readable format) DestinationString: string, # Destination network prefix length DestinationPrefixLength: int, # Gateway address for this route Gateway: ?[]int, # Gateway address for this route (human-readable format) GatewayString: ?string, # Source address prefix for route selection Source: ?[]int, # Source address prefix for route selection (human-readable format) SourceString: ?string, # Source prefix length SourcePrefixLength: ?int, # Preferred source address for outgoing packets PreferredSource: ?[]int, # Preferred source address for outgoing packets (human-readable format) PreferredSourceString: ?string, # Type of Service (TOS) field TOS: int, # Route scope (RT_SCOPE_* value) Scope: int, # Human-readable scope string ScopeString: ?string, # Routing protocol identifier Protocol: int, # Human-readable routing protocol name ProtocolString: ?string, # Route type (RTN_* value) Type: int, # Human-readable route type TypeString: ?string, # Route priority/metric Priority: int, # Routing table number Table: int, # Human-readable routing table name TableString: ?string, # Route flags (RTM_F_* values) Flags: int, # Human-readable flags string FlagsString: ?string, # Next hop ID for multipath routing NextHopID: ?int, # Maximum Transmission Unit for this route MTU: ?int, # Route preference for IPv6 (low/medium/high) Preference: ?int, # Route lifetime in microseconds LifetimeUSec: ?int, # Configuration source for this route ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string, # Configuration state of this route ConfigState: ?string, # Interface index for serialization InterfaceIndex: ?int, # Route metrics (RTAX_* values) Metrics: ?[]int, # TCP congestion control algorithm for this route TCPCongestionControlAlgorithm: ?string )
type RoutingPolicyRule( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) Family: int, # Source address prefix to match FromPrefix: ?[]int, # Source address prefix to match (human-readable format) FromPrefixString: ?string, # Length of source prefix in bits FromPrefixLength: ?int, # Destination address prefix to match ToPrefix: ?[]int, # Destination address prefix to match (human-readable format) ToPrefixString: ?string, # Length of destination prefix in bits ToPrefixLength: ?int, # Routing protocol identifier Protocol: int, # Human-readable routing protocol name ProtocolString: string, # Type of Service (TOS) field to match TOS: int, # Rule action type (FR_ACT_* value) Type: int, # Human-readable rule action type TypeString: string, # IP protocol number to match IPProtocol: int, # Human-readable IP protocol name IPProtocolString: string, # Rule priority (lower value means higher priority) Priority: int, # Firewall mark value to match FirewallMark: int, # Firewall mark mask to apply FirewallMask: int, # Routing table number to use Table: ?int, # Human-readable routing table name TableString: ?string, # Whether rule matching is inverted Invert: bool, # Suppress route lookup if prefix length is less than or equal to this value SuppressPrefixLength: ?int, # Suppress route lookup if interface group matches SuppressInterfaceGroup: ?int, # Source port range to match [start, end] SourcePort: ?[]int, # Destination port range to match [start, end] DestinationPort: ?[]int, # User ID range to match [start, end] User: ?[]int, # Incoming interface name to match IncomingInterface: ?string, # Outgoing interface name to match OutgoingInterface: ?string, # Configuration source for this rule ConfigSource: string, # Configuration state of this rule ConfigState: string )
type SIP( # Address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) for address-based servers Family: ?int, # SIP server IP address Address: ?[]int, # SIP server IP address (human-readable format) AddressString: ?string, # SIP server domain name Domain: ?string, # Configuration source for this SIP server ConfigSource: string, # Address of the configuration provider ConfigProvider: ?[]int, # Address of the configuration provider (human-readable format) ConfigProviderString: ?string )
method Describe() -> ( # All network interfaces managed by systemd-networkd Interfaces: ?[]Interface, # All configured next hops for multipath routing NextHops: ?[]NextHop, # All configured routes across all interfaces Routes: ?[]Route, # All configured routing policy rules RoutingPolicyRules: ?[]RoutingPolicyRule )
method GetStates() -> ( # Overall address configuration state across all interfaces AddressState: LinkAddressState, # IPv4 address configuration state across all interfaces IPv4AddressState: LinkAddressState, # IPv6 address configuration state across all interfaces IPv6AddressState: LinkAddressState, # Carrier state across all interfaces CarrierState: string, # Online state across all interfaces OnlineState: ?LinkOnlineState, # Operational state across all interfaces OperationalState: string )
method GetNamespaceId() -> ( # Network namespace inode number NamespaceId: int, # Network namespace ID (cookie) assigned by the kernel NamespaceNSID: ?int )
method GetLLDPNeighbors( # Filter by interface index (optional) InterfaceIndex: ?int, # Filter by interface name (optional) InterfaceName: ?string ) -> ( # LLDP neighbors grouped by interface Neighbors: []LLDPNeighborsByInterface )
method Reload( # If true (default), reload config files and reconfigure all matching network interfaces. If false, only reload config files without reconfiguring interfaces; use 'networkctl reconfigure' afterwards to apply changes selectively. reconfigureLinks: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
method SetPersistentStorage( # Whether persistent storage is ready and writable Ready: bool ) -> ()
error AlreadyReloading()
error StorageReadOnly()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Network shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Network.Describe '{}' invokes its Describe method.
